meta.title: Kyber — Sarrafa kowace na'ura a ainihin lokaci
meta.description: Kyber ginshiƙin fasaha ne na ainihin lokaci don sarrafa na'urori. 8 ms daga farko zuwa ƙarshe. Robobi, jirage marasa matuƙa, motoci, kwamfutoci daga nesa, duniyoyin kama-da-wane. Ƙungiyar VLC ce ta gina shi.

nav.solutionsLead: SDK ɗaya. Duniyoyi shida inda ya kamata nisa ya ɓace.

home.lead: Kyber ginshiƙin fasaha ne na ainihin lokaci don sarrafa na'urori. Robobi, jirage marasa matuƙa, motoci. Kwamfutoci daga nesa. Duniyoyin kama-da-wane. Har zuwa 8 ms kacal daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, a yanayi mafi dacewa.
home.hudLink: QUIC / HTTP3 · Ɓoyayye daga farko zuwa ƙarshe
home.manifesto: A 200 ms, kallo kake yi. A 8 ms, kai ne ke sarrafawa. An gina kiran bidiyo don tattaunawa, ba don sarrafawa ba. An gina kwamfuta daga nesa don imel, ba don injuna ba. Idan robot na tiyata ya yi jinkirin 200 ms, yankan zai faru inda kake a da — ba inda kake yanzu ba.
home.playLead: Ja ko motsa alamar nuni a cikin filin. Ɗigon mai haske kai ne. Zoben kuma na'urar ce, wadda ke karɓar nufinka ta hanyar sadarwa.
home.playHint: Motsa alamar nuni ko yatsanka a nan
home.lat1d: Alamar nuni a manne take da hannunka. Robot ɗin na motsi yayin da kake motsi.
home.lat2d: Jinkiri da ake iya ji. An tsara shi don jinkiri mai daidaito, ba ƙaramin jinkiri ba.
home.lat3d: Kana kallon abin da ka gama yi. Ya dace da imel. Haɗari ne ga tiyata.
home.lat4d: Jinkiri ya yi yawa. Ba shi da amfani ga duk wani abu na mu'amala.
home.statsLead: Kyber na daidaita bidiyo, sauti, umarnin sarrafawa da bayanan na'urori zuwa agogo ɗaya, tare da jinkirin da bai kai milisakan 10 ba.
home.f1t: Ƙasa da abin da ake iya ji
home.f1d: 8–10 ms daga farko zuwa ƙarshe. Ya fi saurin haɗin ido da hannun ɗan adam.
home.f2d: Bidiyo, sauti, na'urorin ji da sarrafawa — duka a kan jadawalin lokaci ɗaya.
home.f3d: Ɓoyayye daga farko zuwa ƙarshe a kan QUIC/HTTP3. Tasha ɗaya, ta kowace katangar kariya.
home.f4d: Haɗa shi cikin makonni, ba shekaru ba.
home.f5d: Ƙarfin hanyar sadarwa na iya raguwa. Jinkiri ba ya ƙaruwa.
home.f6d: Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, Quest, Vision Pro.
home.solKicker: Sarrafa kowace na'ura a ainihin lokaci
home.solLead: SDK ɗin Kyber ɗaya ne ke ba da ƙarfi ga robobin tiyata da kwamfutoci daga nesa, rundunonin jirage marasa matuƙa da tabaran XR. Yana aiki a duk inda ya kamata nisa ya ɓace.
home.pipeLead: Babu ma'ajiyar jira tsakanin matakai. Da zarar wani mataki ya gama, Kyber na turawa zuwa na gaba.
home.vlcKicker: Ƙungiyar VLC ce ta gina shi
home.vlcTitle: Mun warware matsalar bidiyo ga biliyoyin mutane. Yanzu muna warware sarrafawa.
home.vlcLead: Shekaru ashirin na gina ginshiƙan bidiyo. VLC a kan biliyoyin na’urori. Gudummawa mai zurfi ga FFmpeg. Mutanen da suka warware kunna bidiyo su ne yanzu ke warware sarrafa injuna a ainihin lokaci.
home.vlcStat2: na’urorin da ke amfani da manhajarmu
home.vlcStat3: ms daga farko zuwa ƙarshe da Kyber
home.ossLead: Ginshiƙin Kyber buɗaɗɗen tushe ne ƙarƙashin AGPL v3. Karanta shi, ka ɗauki kwafinsa, ka fitar da samfuri da shi — kuma ka tuntuɓe mu idan kana buƙatar ƙari.
home.tlTitle: Shekaru ashirin da biyar muna motsa ɗigogin hoto. Yanzu, muna motsa injuna.
home.t2001: An buɗe tushen VideoLAN ƙarƙashin GNU GPL a École Centrale Paris.
home.t2003: Jean-Baptiste Kempf ya shiga aikin VLC yana ɗalibi.
home.t2004: VLC ya zarce saukarwa miliyan ɗaya.
home.t2006: JB ya karɓi jagoranci kuma ya sake tsara ƙungiyar da lambar shirin.
home.t2008: VideoLAN ya zama ƙungiya mai zaman kanta da ba ta neman riba.
home.t2009: VLC ya zarce masu amfani miliyan 100 a duniya.
home.t2012: An kafa Videolabs don gina kayayyaki da ayyuka a kan VLC.
home.t2024: Kyber ya fara a matsayin aikin gefe don watsawa a ainihin lokaci.
home.t2025: An kafa kamfanin Kyber a Paris. VLC ya kai saukarwa biliyan 6.
home.t2026a: Kyber ya fito daga ɓoye da jarin farko na $5M ƙarƙashin jagorancin Lightspeed.
home.t2026b: VLC ya zarce saukarwa biliyan 7. Kyber 0.28 ya kawo na’urorin masauki na macOS (sigar gwaji ta farko).
home.vlcS3: masu sa kai da ke bayan VLC
home.vlcS4: daga farko zuwa ƙarshe da Kyber
home.vlcAlso: VideoLAN ya kuma ba duniya x264, dav1d da tsarin buɗaɗɗe na DVD da Blu-ray.
home.playNote: Saitunan misalai ne na jinkirin da aka ƙara wa shigarwarka — ba ma’aunin gwaji ba ne.
home.pipeKyber: Kyber daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, a yanayi mafi dacewa
home.pipeCall: Kiran bidiyo na yau da kullum
home.pipeFits: A 120 Hz firam ɗaya yana ɗaukar 8.3 ms. An tsara dukkan hanyar aikin Kyber — daga ɗauka zuwa nunawa — don ta dace a cikinsa.
home.t2020: Kyber ya fara a matsayin aikin gefe lokacin da JB yake CTO a Shadow, kamfanin wasannin girgije.
home.t2022: Kyber 0.1.0: masauki da manhajar mai amfani na Windows da Linux ta haɗin QUIC ɗaya mai ɓoyewa.
home.t2023: An gabatar da Kyber a bainar jama’a a KDE Akademy.
home.ossRepoLead: An raba Kyber zuwa ma’ajiyoyi masu manufa ɗaya-ɗaya — ginshiƙi, manhajoji, abubuwan dogaro da ayyukan gudanarwa. Galibi Rust, tare da VLC da FFmpeg.
home.rk_kyber: Inda za a fara, takardun bayani da bayanan fitarwa
home.rk_kyctl: Matakin sarrafawa: kafa zama, tantance shaida, tsara aiki
home.rk_kymux: Matakin bayanai: kowane bayit, an haɗa su ta QUIC
home.rk_kynput: Ɗauka da sanya shigarwa: madannai, linzamin kwamfuta, na’urorin wasa, allon kwafi
home.rk_kymedia: Ɗauka, ɓoye lamba, warware lamba da nunawa
home.rk_kyutil: Abubuwan haɗin gwiwa da sadarwa tsakanin shirye-shirye
home.rk_desktop: Sabobi da manhajojin mai amfani na Windows, macOS da Linux
home.proofTitle: Tuni yana motsa injuna na gaske.
home.proof1d: A fannin tsaro, sadarwa, mutum-mutumi da ƙirƙirarriyar basira.
home.proof2d: Har zuwa €3.7M daga France 2030 don watsa hotunan likitanci na 3D masu nutsarwa daga kwamfutoci masu nisa.
home.proof3d: Kwanaki huɗu na nune-nune kai tsaye a rumfar Scaleway, da jawabi tare da Inria.
home.proof4d: $5M tare da OVNI Capital da Kima Ventures. Ƙungiyar mutum 26 a lokacin sanarwa.

cta.devTitle: Buɗaɗɗen tushe. Lasisin AGPL. Haɗa shi cikin makonni.
cta.entTitle: Lasisin kasuwanci, tallafi na keɓe da aiwatarwa bisa buƙata.

remote-desktop.name: Tebur na Nesa
remote-desktop.short: Aiki daidai wa daida daga ko’ina
remote-desktop.card: Maye gurbin tsohon tsarin da wanda masu haɓaka manhajarku da masu amfani ba za su yi ƙorafi a kai ba.
remote-desktop.lead: Tebur na nesa mai ƙarfin aiki ga kowace na’ura. Tashar shiga guda ɗaya. Yana aiki lafiya da katangar tsaro. Saurin amsawa, ingancin hoto da ikon sarrafawa kamar na kwamfutar da ke gabanka — duk inda kake.
remote-desktop.capTitle: Shiga daga nesa ya zama tarihi. Lokacin sarrafawa daga nesa ya zo.
remote-desktop.c1d: Kowane rafi an ɗaure shi da agogo mai daidaiton ƙasa da ms 10, don haka na’urarka ta nesa tana amsawa kamar kwamfutar da ke kan teburinka.
remote-desktop.c2d: Rafi mai inganci da ƙarancin jinkiri da ke dorewa a hanyoyin sadarwar kamfani marasa tabbas da saurin intanet mai sauyawa.
remote-desktop.c3d: Tashar shiga guda ɗaya mai ɓoyayyen sadarwa ta cikin kowace katangar tsaron kamfani. Babu wahalar VPN. Babu saitunan hanyar sadarwa masu rauni.
remote-desktop.b1t: Yaɗa hoto daidai har ƙaramin ɗigo
remote-desktop.b1d: Saurin hotuna mai daidaito ga 3D, bidiyo, CAD da ayyukan zane masu sarƙaƙiya.
remote-desktop.b2d: Isar da umarni kusan nan take daga na’ura zuwa allo.
remote-desktop.b3d: macOS, Windows da Linux a ɓangarorin biyu. Ba a ɗaure ka da wani dandali ɗaya ba.
remote-desktop.b4t: An gina shi don katangar tsaro
remote-desktop.b4d: Yana wucewa ta katangar tsaron kamfani ta tashar shiga guda ɗaya.
remote-desktop.useTitle: Tebur, ba tare da iyaka ba.
remote-desktop.u1d: Cikakkiyar damar shiga na’urorin GPU don 3D, bidiyo da CAD ba tare da rage inganci ba.
remote-desktop.u2d: Na’urori masu ƙarfi daga nesa ta hanyar ƙananan kayan aiki na gida.
remote-desktop.u3d: Nuna abin da ake buƙata kawai. Ƙarancin wuraren da za a iya kai hari.
remote-desktop.u4t: VDI, ba tare da wahala ba
remote-desktop.u4d: Madadi mafi sauƙi da sauri ga tsofaffin tsarin VDI.
remote-desktop.u5d: Isa ga tsarurruka masu muhimmanci ba tare da fallasa bayanai ko ginshiƙan tsarin ba.
remote-desktop.u6d: Babban gwajin jinkiri. Idan ya jure a nan, zai jure ko’ina.
remote-desktop.xTitle: Mai daidaita kansa. Mai ƙwazo. Mai faɗaɗuwa.
remote-desktop.x1d: Zaman aiki suna daidaita kansu da sauyin saurin intanet da jinkiri maimakon tsayawa ko yankewa.
remote-desktop.x2d: Haɗa daga na’urori da dama, ko’ina. Tebur ɗaya, aiki iri ɗaya.
remote-desktop.x3t: An gina shi don aiki a babban mataki
remote-desktop.x3d: Dandalin gudanarwa don masu amfani, na’urori da izinin shiga.

xr.name: Gogewar Nutsawa
xr.short: Zana hoto a gajimare, kasancewa a wurin
xr.card: Ƙididdiga mai nauyi a gajimare. Nutsawa a kan na’ura.
xr.lead: Motsi, umarni, sauti da hotuna suna tafiya tare kamar abu ɗaya. Nutsawa na karyewa da zarar jinkiri ya bayyana — Kyber na kiyaye zagayen, ko da ana zana hotuna a gajimare.
xr.c1d: Kowane abin ji a kan agogo ɗaya yana kawar da baƙon jin rashin daidaito. Duniyoyin kama-da-wane suna jin ƙaƙƙarfa kamar na zahiri.
xr.c2d: Gudun matakin sarrafawa yana sa motsinka da allo su tafi daidai a kan Quest da Vision Pro.
xr.c3d: Mayar da zana hotuna zuwa gajimare don ayyukan Unreal da Unity da ke tsayawa daram a kowace hanyar sadarwa.
xr.benTitle: An tsara shi don kasancewa a wurin.
xr.b1t: Gajimare, ba tare da tsaiko ba
xr.b1d: Ana zana hotuna daga nesa; mu’amala na jin kamar a kan na’urar take.
xr.b2t: An yi shi don 3D mai nutsarwa
xr.b2d: Yaɗa XR mai buƙatar ƙarfi daga cibiyar ƙididdiga, ba tare da GPU a gefe ba.
xr.b3d: Unity, Unreal, D3D11, Vulkan da yaɗa hoto. Ba sai an sake rubutawa ba.
xr.b4d: Quest, Vision Pro, kwamfuta da yanar gizo daga tsarin ginshiƙi guda.
xr.u1d: Ƙididdiga a cibiya tare da mu’amala nan take.
xr.u2d: Faffaɗan wurare na kama-da-wane ba tare da iyakar GPU na gida ba.
xr.u3d: Jagorar 3D mai saurin amsawa a fagen aiki.
xr.u5d: Horon nutsawa mai maimaituwa a babban mataki.
xr.u6d: Wuraren 3D na tare waɗanda ake jin su tare da gaske.
xr.xTitle: Mai sauri. Daidai lokaci. Mai sauƙin turawa.
xr.x1d: Bin diddigin kai, na’urorin sarrafawa, firikwensin da ƙarin kayan aiki suna manne da zana hoto sosai.
xr.x2d: Sauti, bidiyo, bin diddigi da umarni a kan layin lokaci ɗaya — babu rashin daidaiton da za a ji.
xr.x3d: Sadarwa mai sauƙi, turawa cikin tsaro da isarwa ta yanar gizo.

robotics.name: Mutum-mutumi
robotics.short: Idan na’ura ta kasa aiki da kanta, tuni kana da iko
robotics.card: Horarwa, sa ido, karɓar iko — nan take.
robotics.titleA: Basirar wucin gadi ta zahiri na buƙatar
robotics.lead: Matakin ginshiƙi tsakanin nufin ɗan Adam da aikin na’ura. Horarwa, sa ido da karɓar iko nan take ga mutum-mutumi a kowane mataki.
robotics.c1d: Mafi kyawun bayanan horo shi ne lokacin da ɗan Adam ya gyara kuskure. Agogo ɗaya na nufin samfurinka zai koya daga bayanai masu daidaito, marasa lalacewa.
robotics.c2d: Ma’aikaci ɗaya zai iya kula da robobi da dama — idan tsarin ginshiƙin yana da isasshen sauri.
robotics.c3d: Idan sarrafa kai ya gaza, ɗan Adam zai karɓi sitiyari a daidai lokacin da ya gane matsalar. Ba bayan 200 ms ba.
robotics.b1t: Ya fi saurin haɗin hannu da idonka
robotics.b1d: Daidaitawar jikinka tana ɗaukar 30–50 ms. Kyber yana aiki ƙasa da 10 ms.
robotics.b2d: Kyamarori, makirufo, na’urorin auna ƙarfi da matsayi a kan jadawalin lokaci ɗaya. Babu karkacewa.
robotics.b3t: Inganci na iya raguwa, iko ba ya raguwa
robotics.b3d: Hoto mai dushewa a ainihin lokaci ya fi cikakken hoto da ya makara da daƙiƙa biyu.
robotics.b4d: ROS, Linux, Windows. Robobi masu siffar mutum, hannayen robobi, tsarin tiyata, rukunin injuna.
robotics.useTitle: Daga robobi masu siffar mutum zuwa hannayen masana’antu.
robotics.u1d: Horo da kariyar gaggawa ga robobin da ke shiga gidaje da wuraren aiki.
robotics.u2d: Idan jinkiri barazana ce ga rai, kasancewa ƙasa da 10 ms na da matuƙar muhimmanci.
robotics.u3d: Sarrafawa daga nesa ba tare da tura mutane cikin haɗari ba.
robotics.u4d: Sa ido kan rukunin robobi da karɓar iko nan take a yanayi na musamman.
robotics.u5d: Dubawa da gyara nesa da ɗakin sarrafawa.
robotics.u6d: Tsaftatattun bayanan sarrafawa daga nesa don ƙirƙirarriyar basira ta zahiri.

drones.name: Jirage marasa matuƙi
drones.card: Cikakken tsarin IP, ba tare da iyakar rediyo ba. Yana aiki ta Starlink.
drones.titleB: a daidai lokacin da kai ma ka yi.
drones.lead: Gazawar sarrafa kai ba ta bar lokaci don jinkirin 200 ms ba. Kyber yana samar da iko fiye da iyakar gani ta IP, don haka masu sarrafawa suna karɓar iko nan take.
drones.c1d: Kowane rafin bayanai a haɗe tare, don abin da matuƙi ke gani da abin da jirgin ke yi su zama ɗaya.
drones.c2d: Karɓar iko ƙasa da 10 ms na ba matuƙa damar kauce wa cikas kamar suna cikin jirgin.
drones.c3d: Gyaran kuskure tun kafin ya faru na sa umarni su ci gaba da amsawa duk da sauyin ƙarfin sigina.
drones.benTitle: Idanu da hannaye, a ainihin lokaci.
drones.b1t: Sarrafawa da sa ido daga nesa
drones.b1d: Cikakken iko daga nesa tare da sanin halin da ake ciki kai tsaye.
drones.b2d: Tsari ɗaya. Dandamalin jirage marasa matuƙi da yawa. Haɗin gwiwa mara tangarɗa.
drones.b3d: Abubuwan 3D da ake ɗorawa a ainihin lokaci da fahimta mai amfani da ƙirƙirarriyar basira.
drones.b4d: Alamomin lokaci masu cikakken daidaito don koyo da tabbatarwa.
drones.u1d: Sa ido a ainihin lokaci kan ababen more rayuwa da wuraren makamashi.
drones.u2d: Isar da kaya cikin aminci da daidaito. Ko’ina, kowane lokaci.
drones.u3d: Ganin komai da haɗin kai tsakanin ababen hawa da dandamali.
drones.u4d: Jirage masu tashi da na ƙarƙashin ruwa don nema da ceto.
drones.u5d: Rukunoni masu haɗin kai da ke aiki kamar ɗaya.
drones.u6d: Bayanai masu daidaito don koya wa injuna tashi.

autonomous-vehicles.name: Motoci masu tuƙa kansu
autonomous-vehicles.short: Sa ido kan rukunin motoci a babban mataki
autonomous-vehicles.card: Karɓar iko nan take daga ɗan Adam a yanayi na musamman.
autonomous-vehicles.lead: Karɓar iko nan take da bayanan na’urorin ji masu daidaito. Kyber yana tabbatar da cewa rukunin motoci masu tuƙa kansu ba sa taɓa kasancewa su kaɗai.
autonomous-vehicles.c1d: Idan dole ɗan Adam ya shiga, miƙa iko yana tafiya lami lafiya kuma iko na zuwa nan take.
autonomous-vehicles.c2d: Kowane rafin bayanai a haɗe, don bitar abubuwan da suka faru da samfura su ginu kan gaskiya mai daidaito.
autonomous-vehicles.c3d: Shigarwa mai dacewa da katangar tsaro ta tashar guda ɗaya, tare da cikakken gani a duk rukunin motocinka.
autonomous-vehicles.benTitle: Tuƙi da kai ya dogara ga fasaha mai dacewa.
autonomous-vehicles.b1d: Ma’aikaci daga nesa yana karɓar iko da mota guda cikin ƙiftawar ido.
autonomous-vehicles.b2d: Kula da motoci da yawa lokaci guda ba tare da rasa komai ba.
autonomous-vehicles.b3d: Hanyoyin tura bayanai a jere tare da miƙa iko lami lafiya tsakanin hanyoyin sadarwa.
autonomous-vehicles.b4d: Ingantacciyar fahimta ta abubuwan da ake ɗorawa a ainihin lokaci.
autonomous-vehicles.u1t: Jinkirin da ya fi saurin fahimta
autonomous-vehicles.u1d: Masu sarrafawa suna amsawa da sauri fiye da yadda ido zai iya gane.
autonomous-vehicles.u2d: Bidiyo, umarni da bayanai a daidaice don bitar abubuwan da suka faru.
autonomous-vehicles.u3t: Amintacce, mai jituwa da katangar tsaro
autonomous-vehicles.u3d: Yana jurewa a kowane irin yanayin hanyar sadarwa.
autonomous-vehicles.u4d: Taimako daga nesa a ƙananan lokutan da tuƙi da kai ba zai iya warwarewa ba.
autonomous-vehicles.u5d: Tuƙi daga nesa don manyan motoci, taraktoci da motocin jigila.
autonomous-vehicles.u6d: Kowane shiga tsakani yana zama tsaftataccen bayanan horo.

ai-agents.name: Wakilan basirar na'ura
ai-agents.card: Tantance hotuna daga gajimare zuwa na'ura, nan take.
ai-agents.lead: Basira ba tare da jinkiri ba. Kyber yana haɗa tunani na dijital da zahirin duniya, yana rufe giɓin da ke tsakanin hasashen samfuri da tasirinsa a duniyar gaske.
ai-agents.capTitle: Daga na ƙirƙira zuwa na gaske.
ai-agents.c1d: Hasashe a gajimare yana manne da na'urorin zahiri, don martanin wakili ya zo nan take kamar tunaninsa.
ai-agents.c2d: Kowane abin lura da umarni a kan babban agogo guda — tsaftatattun bayanai masu daidaito.
ai-agents.c3d: Haɗi mai tsaro na nan take yana bai wa ɗan adam damar karɓar iko da zarar abubuwa sun yi sarƙaƙiya.
ai-agents.b1d: Hanya mafi sauri don mu'amala da samfurori da wakilai nan take.
ai-agents.b2d: Rafukan bayanai masu tambarin lokaci, daidai da bayanan siffa don cikakken mahallin.
ai-agents.b3d: Sa ido nan take da karɓar iko da hannu don cikakken tsaro.
ai-agents.b4d: Rajistan da suka daidaita don gyaran kurakurai dalla-dalla da horar da samfurori.
ai-agents.u1d: Zagayen fahimta da sarrafawa marasa tsaiko ga injuna masu aiki da kansu.
ai-agents.u2d: Ganowa da amsawa nan take ga muhimman ababen more rayuwa.
ai-agents.u3d: Ƙwarewar ɗan adam a kan na'urori na nesa, ba tare da tsaiko ba.
ai-agents.u4t: Kulawa inda tsaro ya fi komai
ai-agents.u4d: Sa ido inda kowane millisakan ke da muhimmanci.
ai-agents.u5d: Ana yaɗa kyamarori da na'urorin ji ba tare da jinkirin ajiya ba.
ai-agents.u6d: Umarni na isa ga na'ura da zarar an yanke su.
ai-agents.x1d: Ana ɗauka da yaɗa su ba tare da jinkirin ajiya ba, don wakilin ya ga abin da ke faruwa yanzu.
ai-agents.x2d: Samfurin yana tunani bisa abin da ke faruwa yanzu, ba abin da ya wuce ba.
ai-agents.x3d: Umarni na isa ga na'ura nan take, yayin da masu sa ido ke ganin komai daga sama ba tare da tsaiko ba.

tech.titleA: Ka'idar da ke sa injunan nesa
tech.lead: Ɗaukar bidiyo, sauti, umarnin sarrafawa, bayanan na'urorin ji — duk an daidaita su a kan layin lokaci ɗaya, duk ta haɗi ɗaya mai ɓoye.
tech.thrTitle: Ƙasa da saurin ido da hannun ɗan adam
tech.thrLead: Zagayen idonka da hannunka yana ɗaukar 30–50 ms. Kyber yana gudana daga farko zuwa ƙarshe cikin ƙasa da 10 ms, a mafi kyawun yanayi.
tech.thrHuman: Zagayen ido da hannun ɗan adam
tech.pushLead: Yawancin tsarukan nan take suna sanya ma'ajiyar jira tsakanin kowane mataki don daidaita hanyar sadarwa. Za ka samu jinkiri mai daidaito — amma mai yawa. Kyber yana tura bayanai gaba da zarar sun shirya, yana daidaita inganci, ba tare da ƙara jinkiri ba.
tech.clockTitle: Agogo ɗaya da ke mulkin kowane rafi.
tech.clockLead: Kyber yana auna karkacewar agogo ba tsayawa, kuma yana mayar da komai kan layin lokaci guda. Agogon da aka yi amfani da shi kai tsaye shi ne ake amfani da shi wajen sake kunnawa. Babu wahalar daidaita firam. Babu rashin jituwa tsakanin abin da na'urar ta gani da abin da ta yi.
tech.connLead: Jigilar QUIC/HTTP3, an ɓoye ta daga farko zuwa ƙarshe ta tsohuwa. Babu tashoshi daban-daban masu agogo daban-daban da hanyoyin lalacewa daban-daban. Babu saitin katangar tsaro mai tashoshi 25.
tech.prioTitle: Nau'in bayanai biyu. Matakan fifiko biyu.
tech.prioLead: Kana baya da firam goma? Kyber yana nuna maka sabon firam ya yar da sauran. Danna maɓalli — wannan dannawar koyaushe tana isowa.
tech.prioMedia: Kafofi — na baya-bayan nan ke nasara
tech.prioMediaList: Bidiyo da sauti · Bayanan nesa da na'urorin ji · Fassarar rubutu da bayanan siffa
tech.prioCtrl: Sarrafawa — ba a taɓa yarwa ba
tech.prioCtrlList: Linzami, madannai, na'urar wasa, taɓawa · USB, fayiloli, allon kwafi · Ka'idoji na musamman
tech.netTitle: Hanyoyin sadarwa na faɗuwa. Kyber yana daidaitawa.
tech.netLead: Tauraron ɗan adam na rasa haɗi. Hasumiyoyi na cunkushewa. Ja maɓallin zamewa don raunana hanyar sadarwa ka ga abin da Kyber ke karewa.
tech.n1d: Ana sake gina fakitin da suka ɓace a cikin gida.
tech.n2d: Faɗin hanya ya ragu, inganci ya ragu, amma jinkiri bai ƙaru ba.
tech.n3d: Sarrafawa kullum tana gaban ingancin bidiyo.
tech.secTitle: Kariya a matakin ka’idar sadarwa. Tsarin da ba ya amincewa da kowa.
tech.s1d: An gina shi a kan QUIC/HTTP3. Ba ma iya ganin bayananku, ko da sun ratsa ta tsarinmu.
tech.s2d: Izini dalla-dalla: wa zai haɗu, me zai iya isa, me zai iya yi.
tech.s3d: DRM don rafukan bidiyo masu muhimmanci, da hana ɗaukar hoton allo inda tsarin aiki ya yarda.
tech.a2d: Mai sarrafawa ɗaya, rukunin na’urori. Ko masu kallo da yawa, na’ura ɗaya.
tech.a3d: Daga gefen cibiyar sadarwa zuwa gajimare zuwa mai sarrafawa, ta kan iyakokin cibiyoyin sadarwa.
tech.notLead: An gina WebRTC shekaru goma da suka wuce don kiran bidiyo tsakanin mutane. 100–200 ms ba matsala ba ce a hira, amma haɗari ne ga sarrafa na’ura. Manyan kamfanoni sun shafe shekaru suna kashe miliyoyin daloli don gina nasu tsarin sarrafawa daga nesa. Kyber ita ce wannan damar, ga kowa da kowa.
tech.connLegacyD: Hanyoyi daban-daban, agogo daban-daban, matsaloli daban-daban — kuma galibi tashoshin katangar tsaro da yawa.
tech.cmpLate: Firam ɗin bidiyo da suka makara
tech.kLate: Ana watsar da su — sabon firam ne ke nasara
tech.wLate: Ana ajiye su don kunnawa ya yi santsi
tech.kCtrl: Ana sake aikawa, ba a taɓa watsarwa
tech.cmpNote: Manufofin ƙira kamar yadda Kyber ta bayyana — ba gwajin aiki ba ne.
tech.netNote: Misali ne — ba ma’auni ba ne.
tech.scopeLead: Ma’auni na gaske daga wannan shafin: tazarar lokaci tsakanin firam ɗin motsi da jinkirin kafin a karɓi dannawarka da madannanka. Haka kulawa da kowace millisakan take.
tech.scopeTry: Danna, taɓa ko rubuta a ko’ina don auna jinkirin shigarwa.
tech.fecLead: Fakitin bayanai huɗu suna tafiya tare da fakitin daidaito na XOR ɗaya. Idan ɗaya ya ɓace, mai karɓa zai sake gina shi a wurinsa, ba tare da zuwa da dawowa ba. Idan biyu suka ɓace, maidowa ba za ta yiwu ba — shi ya sa Kyber ke daidaita inganci ma.
tech.fecDrop: Danna fakiti don watsar da su
tech.fecOk: An maido a wurin — babu sake aikawa, babu jira
tech.fecFail: Asara ta yi yawa — ana buƙatar sake aikawa
tech.fecModel: Samfurin koyarwa — ba ainihin tsarin FEC na Kyber ba ne

about.lead: Muna gina ginshiƙin da zai sa nisa ya ɓace.
about.storyTitle: Sarrafa na’ura ya tsaya cak a 2010. Muna gyara hakan.
about.story1: Likitan tiyata a Paris yana jagorantar hannun mutum-mutumi a ƙauyen Brittany. Ma’aikacin rumbu a Chicago yana karɓe ragamar motar ɗaga kaya da ta daskare. Mai tuƙa jirgi mara matuƙi yana buƙatar karɓe iko nan take idan na’urar ta rasa jagorancin basirar wucin gadi.
about.story2: A kowane hali, cibiyar sadarwa ita ce abokiyar gaba. A millisakan 200 kana kallon abin da ya riga ya faru. A millisakan 8 kana sarrafa abin da ke faruwa. Wannan ita ce tazara tsakanin kallo da sarrafawa — tsakanin aiki lafiya da haɗari. Mun rufe ta.
about.teamTitle: Daga ƙungiyar da ta gina VLC.
about.teamLead: Waɗanda suka kafa Kyber sun gina VLC — wadda aka saka a biliyoyin na’urori — kuma sun ba da gudummawa ga FFmpeg, injin da ke bayan yawancin bidiyo a intanet. Shekaru ashirin na ginshiƙin bidiyo, buɗaɗɗen tushe da zurfin ilimin ka’idojin sadarwa, yanzu an faɗaɗa su zuwa sabbin fannoni.
about.valuesTitle: Abin da muka yi imani da shi.
about.v1t: Ba ma fitarwa sai ya kammalu
about.v1d: Shekaru ashirin sun koya mana cewa gajerun hanyoyi suna jawo asara fiye da ribarsu. Kowace millisakan tana da muhimmanci.
about.v2d: Buɗewa tana gina amana, tana ba da ’yancin kai, kuma tana gina tsarin haɗin gwiwa.
about.v3t: Na’urori suna yi wa mutane hidima
about.v3d: Likitocin tiyata, masu sarrafawa, injiniyoyi. Fasaha tana ɓacewa; ƙarfin ɗan adam yana ƙaruwa.
about.v4d: Muna fitarwa, sannan mu yi murna. Muna da ƙwarin gwiwa saboda mun ƙware — ba don muna faɗa ba.
about.v5d: Muna ɗaukar ma’aikata masu hazaka da kirki. Mun ƙi ƙwararru da ba su dace da mu ba — kuma za mu sake yi.
about.careersTitle: Guraben aiki da ake da su
about.careersLead: Ƙungiya mai mayar da hankali kan ɗaya daga cikin matsalolin kwamfuta da ba a warware ba tukuna. Hedikwatarmu tana Paris, kuma muna faɗaɗa a San Francisco. Muna aiki cikin hanzari, muna muhawara kan ka’idojin sadarwa, kuma muna gina abubuwan da ke aiki.
about.j5: Injiniya Mai Aiki a Wurin Abokan Ciniki
about.officesLead: Hedikwatarmu tana tsakiyar birnin Paris, tare da cibiyoyi a Amurka da Asiya don tallafa wa abokan ciniki a duk inda suke aiki.
about.stackLine: Muna rubuta shiri da Rust, da C, da kuma harshen inji — tare da ɗan Go.

sdk.lead: SDK ɗaya ne ke tafiyar da robobin tiyata da kwamfutocin nesa, rundunonin jirage marasa matuƙa, tabaran XR da manhajojin burauza.
sdk.k1d: Ƙarƙashin lasisin AGPL. Duba lambar, fahimce ta, inganta ta.
sdk.k2d: Jagorori, bayanan API da misalan ayyuka.
sdk.k3d: Laburarori don kowane dandali da ake tallafawa. Hanyar haɗawa ɗaya tak.
sdk.licOpenD: Kyauta ne don amfani. Dole ne a wallafa mafitan da suka haɗa Kyber ƙarƙashin AGPL. Watsa bidiyo kawai. Tallafin al’umma.
sdk.licComD: Tallafi na musamman, taimako wajen haɗawa, samun damar fasaloli kamar KyHub (shafin gudanarwarmu), raba lambar tushe ba tare da haƙƙin rarrabawa ba.
sdk.matTitle: Abin da ke aiki a ina — a yau.
sdk.matLead: Kai tsaye daga README na aikin da bayanan sabbin fitowa.
sdk.matNotes: Sabar Windows: NVENC, tare da QSV da AMF a matakin gwaji. An gwada Linux a kan sigar Debian mai karko (X11); VAAPI a matakin gwaji. Mai karɓa na burauza: cikakke a Chromium, na gwaji a Firefox, wani ɓangare a WebKit. Mai masaukin macOS yana matakin alfa tun 0.28 (Apple Silicon).
sdk.bindD: Tushen Rust. C ta hanyar cbindgen, JavaScript ta hanyar wasm-bindgen. Swift da Kotlin suna nan tafe.
sdk.clLead: Abin da ya canza a iyakar tsarin, fitowa bayan fitowa.
sdk.r28a: Yanzu macOS na iya zama mai masauki (alfa): ɗaukar allo da ScreenCaptureKit, sauya bidiyo da VideoToolbox.
sdk.r28b: Ba a ƙara tura dannawar da ta faɗa kan baƙaƙen ratsin gefe zuwa mai masauki.
sdk.r28c: Injin ɗauka da sauya bidiyo na biyu da aka gina kai tsaye a kan FFmpeg, wanda za a iya zaɓa yayin aiki.
sdk.r28d: Nau’ikan C API yanzu suna da kari na farko iri ɗaya — sauya suna kawai ga masu haɗawa.
sdk.r27a: Masu karɓa da yawa a kan mai masauki ɗaya: ɗauka da sauya bidiyo sau ɗaya, sannan a kwafi rafin.
sdk.r27b: Jadawalin jinkiri kai tsaye na kowane mataki a mai karɓa na yanar gizo: sabar, hanyar sadarwa, burauza.
sdk.r27c: Shiga ta OIDC a cikin burauza — Keycloak, Auth0, Authelia da sauransu.
sdk.r26a: OIDC a kan kwamfuta da sabar, FFmpeg 8.1, gyaran sauya bidiyo na AMD da VAAPI.
sdk.r25a: IPv6, ɗaukar allo ta Linux DRM/KMS, samar da JWT a cikin kyctl.

faq.title: Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi
faq.q1: Wane lasisi kuke amfani da shi?
faq.a1: Tsarin lasisi biyu. Buɗaɗɗen tushe na AGPL v3 kyauta ne don amfani, amma dole ne a wallafa duk mafitan da suka haɗa Kyber ƙarƙashin AGPL; yana ƙunshe da watsa bidiyo tare da tallafin al’umma. Lasisin kasuwanci yana ƙara tallafi na musamman, taimako wajen haɗawa, fasaloli na musamman kamar KyHub, shafin gudanarwarmu, da raba lambar tushe ba tare da haƙƙin rarrabawa ba.
faq.q2: Zan iya girka Kyber da kaina?
faq.a2: E. Bi jagororin girkawa a GitLab ɗinmu: gitlab.com/kyber/kyber.
faq.a3: Da lasisin AGPL v3 za ka samu tallafin al’umma a r/kyber. Don tallafi na musamman, sami lasisin kasuwanci kuma ka tuntuɓi ƙungiyar tallace-tallacenmu.
faq.a4: Babban ofishinmu yana Paris, tare da ofisoshi a San Francisco da Singapore don tallafa wa abokan cinikinmu.
faq.q5: Ta yaya kuke tallafa wa al’ummar buɗaɗɗen tushe?
faq.a5: Babban samfurin Kyber an fitar da shi ƙarƙashin AGPL v3. An gina shi a kan laburarorin VLC da FFmpeg, kuma muna ba da gudummawa sosai ga duka biyun. Muna karɓar baƙuncin kayan aikin buɗaɗɗen tushe da kanmu a duk inda za mu iya, kuma muna mayar da gudummawa.

simple.title: Kyber, cikin sauƙaƙan kalmomi
simple.whatD: Kyber tana bai wa mutane damar sarrafa injuna daga nesa — mutum-mutumi, jirage marasa matuƙa, motoci ko kwamfutoci — kusan ba tare da jinkiri ba. Abin da ka yi yana isa cikin kusan kashi 8 cikin dubu na daƙiƙa.
simple.whoD: Ƙungiyar da ta ƙirƙiri VLC, manhajar kunna bidiyo kyauta da ɗaruruwan miliyoyin mutane ke amfani da ita. Kamfanin yana birnin Paris.
simple.u1: Aiki a kan kwamfuta mai nisa kamar tana gabanka
simple.u2: Jagorantar mutum-mutumi da jirage marasa matuƙa cikin aminci
simple.u3: Taimaka wa motoci masu tuƙa kansu idan suna buƙatar ɗan Adam
simple.u4: Nuna hotunan 3D ga likitoci da injiniyoyi
simple.b2d: Don masu haɓaka manhaja, a GitLab
simple.back: Koma zuwa cikakken shafin yanar gizo
simple.whatD2: Yana aiki kamar kiran bidiyo kai tsaye da na’ura: kuna ganin allonta ko kyamararta, kuma linzaminku, madannin rubutu ko sandar sarrafawa suna isa gare ta nan take.
simple.why: Me ya sa yake da muhimmanci?
simple.whyD: Idan kuna tuƙa mutum-mutumi ko mota daga nesa, kowane ɗan lokaci yana da muhimmanci. Kiran bidiyo na yau da kullum na iya jinkiri har zuwa kashi ɗaya cikin biyar na daƙiƙa — wanda ya isa ku wuce kwana. An gina Kyber don ya fi saurin abin da idanunku da hannayenku za su iya lura da shi.
simple.h1: Shigar da Kyber a kan na’urar da kuke son sarrafawa.
simple.h2: Buɗe Kyber a kwamfutarku, a burauzarku ko a kan na’urar sakawa a kai.
simple.h3: Haɗa. Hoto, sauti da sarrafawa suna tafiya tare ta hanyar haɗi ɗaya da aka ɓoye — cikin sauri da sirri.
simple.freeD: Eh. Lambar tushe a buɗe take kuma kyauta ce don amfani. Kamfanonin da ke buƙatar amfani na sirri, tallafi ko fasaloli na musamman za su iya samun lasisin kasuwanci.
simple.listenAria: Saurari karatun wannan shafin da babbar murya
simple.audioErr: Ba a iya loda sautin ba. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa nan gaba.

sdkm.title: Shigar, gina kuma gudanar da Kyber
sdkm.lead: Zaɓi dandalinku. Kowane layi yana da nasa maɓallin kwafa — ko ku kwafi dukan rukunin.
sdkm.dStart: Kwafo babban ma’ajiya: gabatarwa, takardu da taswirar kowane ɓangaren Kyber.
sdkm.dLinux: Gina manhajar tebur ta mai amfani da ta mai masauki daga lambar tushe. An gwada a Debian Bookworm da Ubuntu 24.04.
sdkm.dMac: Gina manhajar mai amfani ta macOS da sigar gwaji ta mai masauki. Yana buƙatar Rust da kayan aikin layin umarni na Xcode.
sdkm.dWin: Hanya mafi sauri ita ce manhajar shigarwa ta Windows da aka sa wa hannu: manhajar mai amfani, mai masauki da ta yanar gizo a kunshi ɗaya. Gina daga lambar tushe yana haɗawa daga Linux zuwa Windows.
sdkm.dRun: Kunna mai masauki a kan na’urar da kuke son sarrafawa, sannan ku haɗa daga manhajar mai amfani.
sdkm.note: An ɗauko umarnin daga README na hukuma na kyber-desktop. Duba jagorar don sabbin abubuwan dogaro.

car.lead: Sarrafa injuna nan take na ɗaya daga cikin matsalolin kwamfuta da ba a warware ba tukuna. Mu mutane 26 ne daga al'ummar VLC da FFmpeg, muna gina buɗaɗɗiyar siga da kowa zai iya amfani da ita.
car.missionD: A milisakan 200, kuna kallon abin da ya riga ya faru. A milisakan 8, kuna sarrafa abin da ke faruwa. Muna rufe wannan giɓi — ga likitocin tiyata, masu sarrafa injuna, matuƙan jirage marasa matuƙi da wakilan ƙirƙirarriyar basira — kuma muna wallafa lambar tushe domin kowa ya iya gini a kanta.
car.legacyD: Ƙungiyar da ta kafa mu ce ta gina VLC, manhajar kunna bidiyo da ke kan biliyoyin na'urori, kuma ta ba da gudummawa ga FFmpeg, injin da ke bayan yawancin bidiyon intanet. Kyber tana ɗaukar darussan shekaru ashirin da aka koya da ƙyar game da agogo, kodek da hanyoyin sadarwa — kuma tana karkata su ga injuna.
car.legacy2: 2008 · VideoLAN ta zama ƙungiya mara riba
car.legacy3: 2020 · Kyber ta fara a matsayin aikin gefe
car.teamD: Za ku yi aiki kai tsaye da mutanen da suka rubuta lambar da kuke amfani da ita kullum — babu masu shiga tsakani.
car.envT: Injiniyanci da farko. Sauran komai daga baya.
car.e1d: Da ɗan Go. Muna kula da kowane zagaye, kowane kwafi da kowane jerin gwano.
car.e2d: Yawancin abin da kuka gina ana fitar da shi ƙarƙashin AGPL a GitLab, tare da sunanku a cikin tarihi.
car.e3d: Babu wasan kwaikwayon rahotanni. Mutanen da suka fahimci matsalar ne ke yanke shawara.
car.e4d: Cikakken 'yanci a shawarwarin fasaha, daga tsarin gini har zuwa milisakan ƙarshe.
car.e5d: Ku yi aiki daga ofishinmu na Paris, a tsarin gauraye, ko gaba ɗaya daga nesa a cikin Turai.
car.e6d: Mutummutumi, jirage marasa matuƙi, na'urorin XR na kai, hotunan tiyata — tsarukan da jinkiri a cikinsu batun tsaro ne.
car.perksT: Muhimman abubuwa, an yi su yadda ya kamata.
car.p3: Kashi 50% na kuɗin katin sufurin jama’a
car.p4: A ofis, gauraye ko daga nesa gaba ɗaya a Turai
car.p6: Kayan aiki na zamani: XR, mutum-mutumi, GPU
car.perksNote: Alfanun suna bin dokoki da al’adun Faransa; cikakkun bayanai sun dogara da kwangila da wurin aiki.
car.valuesK: Abin da muka yi imani da shi
car.pr1d: Ƙwarin gwiwarka, dacewarka, da duk tambayoyinka da ba na fasaha ba.
car.pr2d: Yadda kake warware matsaloli, tare da CTO ɗinmu da/ko babban mai tsara mafita.
car.pr3d: Zama na sakin jiki don tabbatar da cewa za mu ji daɗin aiki tare.
car.noRoleD: Muna ɗaukar mutane na musamman, ba sunayen muƙamai ba. Faɗa mana abin da za ka gina.

car.aboutD: Kyber SDK ne mai buɗaɗɗen tushe kuma dandali don sarrafa na’urori daga nesa — tun daga kwamfutoci na nesa har zuwa tuƙa mutum-mutumi daga nesa. Hanyar jigila guda ɗaya mai rafuka da masu motsa na’ura da yawa a kan QUIC, da ƙarancin jinkiri matuƙa. Injiniyoyi daga al’ummar VLC da FFmpeg ne suka gina shi.
